name: Geiger and Marsden’s large-angle scattering
description: Observation of rare large-angle scattering of alpha particles.

impact.note: One experiment in one laboratory with a surprising result; the nuclear model of the atom and scattering as a method came out of it.

places.note: Location associated with the documented account.

date.label: 17 June 1909
date.basis: Date the report was read, according to its heading; observations were earlier.

events.statement: Geiger and Marsden reported diffuse reflection of alpha particles at large angles in a paper read to the Royal Society on 17 June 1909.

evidence.supports: The paper’s heading names both authors, Rutherford as communicator, and the read date; it reports large deflections.
